IGUI_HARMONIE_AssessmentLocked: Requires First Aid level %1 to interpret
IGUI_HARMONIE_KeybindAssess_tt: Opens the Nutrition Assessment window for yourself, or the nearest other player if one is close by.
IGUI_HARMONIE_KeybindAdmin_tt: Admin/debug only: opens the live vitamin + sandbox tuning panel. Bound to / by default.
IGUI_HARMONIE_AdminHint: Type values, then press Save at the bottom to apply everything at once. Hover any field for details.
IGUI_HARMONIE_AdminReserveTooltip: Type a new Reserve value (0-100) and press Save to apply it. Below the Critical threshold the deficiency penalty can fire (unless Pause Days are banked); at or above the Sufficient threshold it counts as fully recovered. Accepts decimals (e.g. 19.99) for testing right at a threshold.
IGUI_HARMONIE_AdminPauseDaysTooltip: Banked days that pause BOTH this vitamin's daily Reserve decay AND its critical-deficiency penalty, whichever it's needed for. 1 day is consumed per in-game day. Gained from eating well (reservePerPauseDay Reserve = 1 day), or from taking a crafted Multivitamin pill, which also raises Reserve itself for every vitamin at once. Display-only here -- set Reserve instead to test a deficiency.

IGUI_HARMONIE_SufficientNote: Reserve is healthy. No penalty active.
IGUI_HARMONIE_PauseDaysTooltip: Banked days temporarily hold off the deficiency penalty -- they do NOT stop decay from resuming once they run out. Gained by eating well, or from a crafted Multivitamin pill. To actually clear the affliction for good, eat this vitamin's foods until Reserve reaches Sufficient. Each afflicted vitamin also caps your Endurance 10 percent lower, stacking -- banked pause days shield this too.
